name: Carioca
steps: Stand sideways to your travel lane in a light athletic stance with knees soft and arms held loosely at your sides for balance.
Step your trailing leg swiftly across in front of your lead leg while rotating your hips cleanly toward the travel direction.
Step your lead leg out to the side, then bring your trailing leg quickly behind your lead leg with an opposite hip turn.
Maintain a light, quick alternating crossover rhythm across the lane and repeat facing the opposite direction.
tips: Stay springy on the balls of your feet and let your hips rotate freely while your shoulders stay square forward.
Start at a smooth, rhythmic pace before increasing foot speed.
